note: Sequence count is context-in-depth-samples-based, so it is identical across patch sizes (46,387 sequences of 4096 depth-samples each, per-well contiguous, no cross-well concatenation). Patch size only changes patches-per-sequence (128 at patch32, 256 at patch16) and therefore attention-sequence-length. approx_* counts ignore per-well remainder padding at the tail of each well (well lengths are not exact multiples of 4096); exact counts require per-well floor-division and will be slightly lower than total_depth_samples // 4096 applied globally. Model size stays at S (12 layers, d512, 8 heads, ~25M) pending review of these counts.
